records.name: Taban
records.facts_used: Taban belongs to the Stefanus / Stephanus family in Edgar Rajandi’s Estonian name dictionary. He explains the Greek base as “crown, wreath, diadem” and explicitly includes this spelling among the forms used in Estonia. The spelling is documented in Raamat nimedest, published in Tallinn in 1966. The entry brings together several local adaptations of an older international name; it does not give a first birth registration or say that all the variants began to be used at the same time.

records.name: Sten
records.facts_used: Rajandi gives two associations for Sten: a link to Stefanus, whose Greek base means “crown, wreath”, and the Scandinavian explanation from sten, “stone”. These are distinct analyses, not two parts of one compound. Both accounts appear in his 1966 Estonian name lexicon. The stone explanation is compared with Thorsten and with names such as Petrus and Kalju by meaning. This comparison does not prove that an individual Estonian Sten was named through any one of those names.
